rationale: The controller needs an explicit immutable heartbeat interval for renewable ownership and stale-controller detection. It is distinct from stale_after_seconds: this is the reporting cadence, while stale_after_seconds is the failure threshold.
alternatives: derive it from stale_after_seconds, which couples two independent operational choices
remove it only if the controller protocol has one fixed, non-configurable heartbeat interval
simplestChoice: Keep heartbeat_seconds as an integer in controller_policy.
